# How much can you put in your Solo 401(k) in 2026?

> Free calculator for the 2026 Solo 401(k) contribution limit for a sole proprietor or single-member LLC — employee elective deferral (up to $24,500, or $32,500/$35,750 with catch-up), employer profit-sharing contribution (20% of net self-employment earnings), and the combined $72,000/$80,000/$83,250 overall limit.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
